SELECT r.bill_month AS billMonth, r.currency AS currency, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wms_client_billing_record r
GROUP BY r.bill_month, r.currency

SELECT r.logistics_product_id AS productId, r.currency AS currency, COUNT(*) AS usageCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS amount FROM wms_client_billing_record r
GROUP BY r.logistics_product_id, r.currency ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT r.erp_tenant_id AS erpTenantId, t.tenant_name AS ownerName, r.currency AS currency, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS usageCount FROM wms_client_billing_record r LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = r.erp_tenant_id
GROUP BY r.erp_tenant_id, t.tenant_name, r.currency ORDER BY amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabled FROM sys_tenant WHERE tenant_type = 'ERP_USER' AND parent_wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabled FROM wms_logistics_product WHERE wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND deleted = 0
